Build the CTAS gsm-shaped dfMetrics audit table

MakeMetric_CTAS.Rd

One row per unique (parameter_category_2, parameter_category_3) pair in the unfiltered stacked CTAS results, so every field the pipeline scored appears in the table. Carries the labels the gsm.kri overview widget and per-metric bar chart consume, plus one column per CTAS parameter (Feature toggles, sample-size gates, scoring / padjust methods, seed) harvested from each metric workflow's meta: block.

Usage

MakeMetric_CTAS(
  dfResults,
  lMetricWorkflows = NULL,
  vThreshold = c(0.842, 2.326),
  dfInput = NULL
)

Arguments

dfResults

data.frame Unfiltered stacked CTAS results, typically Reporting_Results$results from the reporting Results workflow. Must carry parameter_category_2 (field) and parameter_category_3 (metric family). parameter_id and parameter_category_1 are copied through when present.

lMetricWorkflows

list Metric workflow YAML objects (workr::MakeWorkflowList() output from inst/workflow/2_metrics). Each element's meta: block supplies the CTAS parameter columns for the workflow whose meta$ID matches parameter_category_3. Metric families with no matching workflow get NA in the parameter columns. Default NULL -> every parameter column is NA.

vThreshold

numeric Threshold values used by Flag_CTAS(). Written verbatim into the Threshold string. Default c(0.842, 2.326).

dfInput

data.frame Optional stacked CTAS input frame (Reporting_Results$input), used only to look up parameter_name for each parameter_id. NULL -> parameter_name is NA.

Value

data.frame with the gsm-shaped dfMetrics columns (MetricID, Abbreviation, Metric, Score, Threshold, GroupLevel, AnalysisType, Model) plus the CTAS identity columns (parameter_id, parameter_name, parameter_category_1, parameter_category_2, parameter_category_3) and one column per CTAS parameter surfaced from the metric YAMLs.

Abbreviation is the short label the gsm.kri site-overview widget uses as each metric column's header (see gsm.viz defineMetricColumns: label: metric.Abbreviation); an empty Abbreviation renders as an empty column header. It is set here to parameter_category_2.

Details

MetricID is ctas_<parameter_category_3>_<parameter_category_2> – family-granular so each (field, metric family) pair carries its own CTAS parameter values distinctly. This is not the field-level MetricID scheme emitted by Summarize_CTAS() (ctas_<field>); Report_CTAS() collapses it to that scheme internally before handing it to gsm.kri::MakeCharts().

See also

Report_CTAS() for the end-to-end reporting pipeline.
